verdict.rationale: v0's docs say Projects can connect to database integrations such as Neon Serverless Postgres, Upstash Redis and Supabase. They also say integrations are automatic with "no accounts required", that v0 "connects to databases as it builds", and that a Project shares environment variables and stored credentials across its chats. Together this supports provisioning a database and wiring it into the app from inside the builder. Missing for 10: a step-by-step first-party walkthrough of the in-builder provisioning and env-var wiring flow, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the database setup works end to end.
